faq.heading:
Everything you need
to know before starting.
faq.description: Some of the most common questions before starting a project. If you need to know anything else, we can talk about it directly.

q1.question: What kind of websites do you develop?
q1.answer: We develop corporate websites, portfolios, landing pages and online stores. Each project adapts to the needs, goals and characteristics of each business.

q2.question: How long does it take for a website to be ready?
q2.answer: The time depends on the type and scope of the project. A simple website can be ready in a few days, while an online store or a more custom project requires more development and review time.

q3.question: Will my website look good on mobile devices?
q3.answer: Yes, all our websites are designed to be fully responsive and offer an excellent experience on every device, from computers to smartphones.

q4.question: Can I have WhatsApp buttons and social media links on my website?
q4.answer: Yes, we can integrate contact buttons and links to your social media directly into your website, and they are included in all our packs. This makes it easier for your customers to get in touch and improves engagement with your brand.

q5.question: Are the domain and hosting included?
q5.answer: Yes, the domain and hosting are included in all our packs. They are renewed annually and we provide all the information you need to manage them without complications.

q6.question: Can I modify my website content afterwards?
q6.answer: Yes. Depending on the project, we can add an admin panel so you can manage content, products or other information without modifying the code.

q7.question: Do I need to know how to code to modify my website?
q7.answer: No, you don't need any programming knowledge. The admin panel we implement is intuitive and easy to use, allowing you to update text, images and other content easily.

q8.question: Do you offer maintenance and support after the website is published?
q8.answer: Yes. We offer a maintenance and support service to make changes, update content, add new features, review technical performance and keep evolving the site.

q9.question: Do I have access to my website's source code?
q9.answer: Yes, as soon as the website is ready we will share a private repository with all the source code and project files. This gives you full control over your website and the possibility to make changes or migrate it if you wish.
